blocks.prompt: 5. If the three sides of a right-angled triangle of perimeter equal to \(36\,cm\) are in A.P. find them.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sawal A.P. aur geometry ko jorta hai. Right-angled triangle (samkon tikon, jis ka ek angle \(90^{\circ}\) ho) ki teeno sides A.P. mein hain, yani barabar farq se barhti hain.
Diya kya hai? Perimeter (teeno sides ka jama) 36 cm, aur triangle right-angled hai.
Find kya karna hai? Teeno sides ki lambai.
Plan: sides ko \(a - d,\ a,\ a + d\) maanna; perimeter se \(a\) aur Pythagoras theorem se \(d\) nikalna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: sides A.P. mein hain, perimeter \(= 36\) cm, triangle right-angled hai.
Humein find karna hai: teeno sides.
Tareeqa: Teen numbers A.P. mein hon to unhein \(a - d,\ a,\ a + d\) likhna sab se behtar hai, kyunke jama karne par \(d\) cancel ho jata hai aur seedha \(3a\) bachta hai. \(d\) ko positive lein to sab se lambi side \(a + d\) hogi, aur right-angled triangle mein sab se lambi side hypotenuse (wtar, right angle ke saamne wali side) hoti hai.

Perimeter istemal karein
\[(a - d) + a + (a + d) = 36\]
\[3a = 36\]
\[a = 12\]
Kyun: Perimeter teeno sides ka jama hai. \(-d\) aur \(+d\) aapas mein cancel ho gaye, isi liye yeh symmetric tareeqa itna kaam ka hai: ek hi qadam mein beech wali side 12 cm mil gayi.

Pythagoras theorem lagayein
\[(a - d)^2 + a^2 = (a + d)^2\]
\[(12 - d)^2 + 144 = (12 + d)^2\]
Kyun: Right-angled triangle mein: (hypotenuse)\(^2\) = baqi do sides ke squares ka jama. Chhoti do sides \(a - d\) aur \(a\) hain, hypotenuse \(a + d\). \(a = 12\) rakha to \(a^2 = 144\).

Expand kar ke solve karein
\[(12 - d)^2 = 144 - 24d + d^2\]
\[(12 + d)^2 = 144 + 24d + d^2\]
\[288 - 24d = 144 + 24d\]
\[144 = 48d\]
\[d = 3\]
Kyun: \((12 - d)^2 = 144 - 24d + d^2\) aur \((12 + d)^2 = 144 + 24d + d^2\). Dono taraf \(d^2\) cancel ho gaya; left par \(144 + 144 = 288\) bacha. Phir dono taraf se 144 minus aur \(24d\) jama kiya to \(144 = 48d\), yani \(d = 3\).
Dhyan dein: \((12 - d)^2\) ko \(144 - d^2\) likhna bohat aam ghalti hai; beech wali term \(-24d\) kabhi mat bhooliye.

Sides likhein
\[a - d = 9,\quad a = 12,\quad a + d = 15\]
Kyun: \(a = 12\) aur \(d = 3\) rakh diye. Sides 9, 12, 15 waqai A.P. mein hain (har dafa 3 ka farq).

Tasdeeq
\[9 + 12 + 15 = 36 \;\checkmark\]
\[9^2 + 12^2 = 81 + 144\]
\[= 225 = 15^2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Perimeter 36 hai aur Pythagoras theorem bhi poora ho raha hai. Dilchasp baat: 9, 12, 15 asal mein mashhoor 3, 4, 5 triangle ka teen guna hai.
blocks.final_answer:
Sides \(9\) cm, \(12\) cm aur \(15\) cm hain.
Yeh mashhoor 3-4-5 right triangle ka 3 guna hai.
